necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation (I48.0) and supraventricular tachycardia (I47.1) in the setting of known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended monitoring period. This service is medically necessary to evaluate the specific cardiac conditions documented in the clinical indication note.
